Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 120: March 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #120 shipped to subscribers in February 2011 (bearing the cover date of March 2011 for Issue 120). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #120 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Operation Flashpoint: Red River (tactical first-person shooter)
Dynasty Warriors 7 (action hack-and-slash)
Top Spin 4 (sports tennis simulation)
Section 8: Prejudice (Xbox Live Arcade futuristic FPS)
Nin2-Jump (Xbox Live Arcade action platformer)
Yar's Revenge (Xbox Live Arcade rail shooter)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Gears of War 3, Modern Warfare 3, and Portal 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
